New York ATA certified translation is a critical service to thousands of people each year. At AET, we offer translation and interpretation in New York NY that is second to none. Whether you need us for ATA certified translation in New York NY or any other service we provide, we will do whatever it takes to earn the trust you have put in our team of experts. No one surpasses our New York translation and interpretation services. We provide reliable, affordable translation and interpretation that meet the highest industry standards.

Why ATA Certification Matters

American Translators Association certification is very important and widely accepted in the USA. New York ATA certified translation means that a translator is specifically qualified to translate a certain language pair, such as Spanish to English. At AET, we offer translation in New York NY in more than 100 languages, also provide interpretation services in most popular languages. These are just a few examples:

  • African languages – Afrikaans, Berber, Shona, Somali, Swahili, Yoruba and many others.
  • Asian languages –Bengali, Chinese, Hindi, Indonesian, Laotian, Japanese, Korean and more.
  • European languages – Czech, English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Russian, Serbian, Swedish and others.
  • Languages of the Americas – Brazilian Portuguese, Haitian Creole and more.
  • Middle Eastern languages – Arabic, Farsi, Hebrew, Turkish, Urdu and several more.

Academic, Legal Translation Services and More

Our New York ATA certified translation professionals provide translation and interpretation in several environments. We can translate documents such as academic transcripts and college degrees, as well as legal documents. AET provides ATA certified translation in New York NY that is accurate and complete, regardless of how complex the subject matter may be.

Please contact AET if you would like more information on ATA certified translation in New York NY. We provide not only New York translation and interpretation, but also many other services. Contact us online or give us a call for more information.
